GenRPC bundle dependencies for the gen_rpc bundle.

class gen_rpc.setup.dependencies.GenRPCBundleDependencies[source]¶

Bases: TypedDict

GenRPC bundle dependencies for the gen_rpc bundle.

It defines:

attributes:
base - The base bundle with the base components for the gen_rpc bundle.
service - The service orchestrating the gen_rpc’s execution for the gen_rpc bundle.
subprocessor - The adapter executing the gen_rpc’s sub-processes for the gen_rpc bundle.
cli - The command-line interface adapter for the gen_rpc bundle.
